mechanism_narrative: A higher level of CPIAUCSL (inflation index) is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as elevated inflation erodes corporate profit margins and increases perceived economic risk, leading to equity market sell-offs.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL is above the 50th percentile, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 4.0% (as measured by FEDFUNDS) signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 4.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in employment (PAYEMS) signals deteriorating labor market conditions and weakening economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE change > 0.3 and PAYEMS change < -0.5 in the last 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE change > 0.3 and PAYEMS change < -0.5 in the last 3 months, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A GDP growth rate below 0.5% annualized (as measured by GDPC1) signals economic contraction and declining corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 annualized growth rate < 0.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust economic activity and strong corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO is above the 50th percentile, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1500 thousand units (as measured by HOUST) signal a weakening housing market and broader economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST < 1500, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 4.0%) and high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 4.0%) signals an economic recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 4.0% and UNRATE > 4.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: An annualized inflation rate above 3.0% (as measured by CPIAUCSL) signals persistent high inflation, eroding real returns and increasing risk aversion, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL annualized inflation rate > 3.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
